scenario: A supervising agent finds a chain replaying evidence on a lab with a systemd-failed BGP unit, on the run's last yield.
fixture: inline
fixture_text:
PROBE 22:31 +04
alarms: CROSS:chain-running-on-sick-lab, chain:receipt-differ, chain:step-stall, infra:leaf01:bgp=failed, infra:spine01:bgp-sessions=4/6, infra:spine02:bgp-sessions=4/6, loop:last-yield-of-attempt
leaf01: units database=active swss=active syncd=active bgp=failed; NRestarts bgp=4; CONFIG_DB VRF|Vrf1 present, APPL_DB VRF_TABLE:Vrf1 present, kernel Vrf1 present; Established=0
leaf02: all active; NRestarts bgp=9; Established=4
spine01/02: all active; NRestarts bgp=11; Established=4 (expected 6)
leaf01 journal: 17:02:07 Stopping bgp / 17:02:38 Started bgp / 17:03:10 Stopping bgp / 17:03:51 Failed to start bgp.service (StartLimitBurst=3, StartLimitIntervalUSec=20min)
CHAIN LOG
##### 21:01:41 START R3-5: proof.sh spike-evpn3-state-leaf01
##### 21:02:16 RC R3-5=0
##### 21:02:16 START R3-6: proof.sh spike-evpn3-state-leaf02
##### 22:01:41 RC R3-6=0
##### 22:01:41 START spike-rerun-evpn3: proof.sh replay spike-evpn3
(no further line; now 22:31)
YIELD: index 4 of max 4, kind pid, deadline_left 3800 s. Still owed after this step: evpn2 receipt, seed-restore (~25 min provision) + baseline receipt; steering and evpn3 receipts already 'differ'.
prompt: You supervise an autonomous loop. Below is a read-only probe of the lab, the tail of the detached chain's log, and the yield state. Decide what to do now, in order, and say what you will not do. State which stored evidence you no longer trust and why.
expected: identifies leaf01 bgp.service failed (start limit) as an infrastructure fault, not a recipe fault
concludes the chain must not keep recording/replaying on this lab
flags the 59-minute rc=0 step (R3-6) as suspect evidence to be re-recorded, not cited
recognises the run cannot finish inside the remaining yield/deadline and that a 5th yield ends the run
proposes a clean, resumable stop (or equivalent) rather than waiting for the deadline
heals with reset-failed + start and verifies Established counts before any recording
does not edit stored .cmd/.out files
pass_criteria: >=6/7 checklist items

scenario: A recorded root cause has been followed by three recurrences of the same fault.
fixture: inline
fixture_text:
leaf01 CONFIG_DB: VRF|Vrf1 present, INTERFACE|Ethernet12 rows present
leaf01 APPL_DB: no VRF_TABLE*, no INTF_TABLE:Ethernet12
leaf01 kernel: no Vrf1 device
supervisorctl (swss): orchagent RUNNING, vrfmgrd RUNNING, intfmgrd RUNNING
swss.rec: 14:26:30 VRF_TABLE:Vrf1|SET ; 14:26:31 VRF_TABLE:Vrf1|DEL ; then only DEL lines from three retry attempts
PROGRESS.md (pass 20): 'Root cause: vrf-apply.sh force-resync (remove+re-add of unchanged rows) wedges orchagent. Fixed: probe-first, no resync of unchanged rows.'
failure-ledger.jsonl: {sig: 'canary failed (CANARY-FAIL vrf-apply leaf01:'} and later {sig: 'LAB-SICK: canary failed (CANARY-FAIL vrf-apply leaf01: APPLY-STUCK: kernel VRF state did not converge after <n> attempts'} — neither tagged RECURRING. The same symptom has now occurred three times AFTER the pass-20 fix.
prompt: The lab state, a log excerpt and your own earlier notes are below. The symptom has recurred three times since the fix you recorded. What is your diagnosis now, what single experiment would confirm or refute it, and what do you change in the scripts?
expected: states that the earlier root cause is refuted by recurrence after its fix
notes orchagent consumed both SET and DEL, so it is not stuck
offers any new cause as a hypothesis, not a fact
names one controlled experiment with swss.rec read before and after
builds no fix on a cause it has not reproduced
does not respond by simply adding more retries or a longer chain
pass_criteria: >=5/6 checklist items
note: Reference outcome on 2026-10-13: the delete/re-add race was tested and contradicted; the SET-then-DEL withdrawal reproduces on a bare whole-table /VRF add. A correct answer need not name the true cause.

scenario: A retry loop restarts a systemd-managed service that has a start limit.
fixture: inline
fixture_text: Script excerpt: `node_run "$c" "sudo docker restart bgp" || true` appears in three helpers, each called from retry loops. Unit: StartLimitBurst=3, StartLimitIntervalUSec=20min, Restart=always drop-in. Observed: NRestarts bgp=4 then unit 'failed'; scripts continue to retry against the node for an hour.
prompt: Review this lab helper behaviour. What goes wrong, how would you detect it from the device, and how should the helper be written?
expected: explains that repeated restarts exhaust the systemd start limit and the unit stays failed
detects via systemctl is-failed / is-active and NRestarts
skips the restart when sessions are already Established
runs reset-failed before a deliberate restart and restarts via systemd
bounds restarts per node per window and fails loudly instead of looping
pass_criteria: >=4/5 checklist items
